name: master-ruleset
description: Original Backtrader baseline. Observe PR + review + CI requirements before activation.
_governance_notes: Only `hotfix/master-*` PRs may target master; each must carry the `target:master-hotfix` label and an independent minimal repro on master.
R3 changes require explicit core-maintainer approval; admin bypass is allowed only with a recorded emergency reason.
Every master fix must create a forward-port issue and complete equivalent, independently-tested ports to dev/development before being governance-done.

_activation.requires: Reviewed Rule Insights, stable required checks, and recorded PR dry-runs.
